checks.detail: Complete current owner, native/replay worker and stage freezer were read; each parses using Python 3.9 grammar. No source module was imported or invoked.

Preparation source is the separately reviewed unchanged constructor/every-byte helper. Native and independent stages use distinct pinned C++ interpreter sources, unchanged program/microtable/parser start and exact complete prepared input. Original 24 commands, closed three-occurrence Gamma promotion and original target are bound by prior independent reviews.

Freezer fixes preparation 60 s with caller 90 s, query/replay 900 s with caller 930 s, all at 805306368 bytes. Query/replay use 80000000000 microsteps and true parser start 88986; larger heap is a prospective input capacity only. No outcome-based limit revision is authorized.

Owner verifies closure/runtime/argv and performs PS capability preflight before worker activation. Native/replay freezer requires actual preparation byte result and separate ROOT decision; replay worker checks accepted producer request/input/limit/full output prerequisites before compilation/query.

Non-raising signal flags keep source bookkeeping intact. Direct worker handles remain registered until wait4 terminal usage is recorded. Worker clears active before zero-exit checks; pre-spawn cancellation checks prevent a knowingly cancelled subsequent child launch. Runtime/Popen semantics remain an explicit trusted boundary.

Any native worker failure/publication exception after spawning a child retains its fresh leader alive. Owner detects the containment latch or deadline, terminates the still-owned group and reaps its direct worker. Observer failure while leader remains unreaped has group-kill/reap fallback; failed or unconfirmed cleanup cannot qualify.

Every sampled task-owned row, birth, PPID, PGID and RSS is retained. Reaped numeric leader PID is not reacquired. Post-reap membership needs retained birth/group anchors. Complete-host filtering trusts pinned source and PS; no independent host-wide ledger or universal escaped-child guarantee is claimed.

Owner captures own_sample_peak once and reuses it for combined_bytes and ROOT_peak_bytes. Combined sample equals own peak plus summed active owned RSS plus observer maximum. Final conservative accounting deliberately includes rolled kernel usage more than once; no subtraction or historical discount.

Closed ledger/provisional receipt is followed by actual post-write time/SELF observation. Candidate hard-link occurs only on pass. Final stdout includes cancelled_at_final_print; ROOT must reject late cancellation or nonterminal/nonzero tool result. A candidate terminal link alone is insufficient authority.

Worker reconstructs every microcode byte and every initial symbol; validates exact six-token native handshake, bounded steps, terminal state, full-band alphabet/capacity/output length. Replay compares all complete output bytes and status/microsteps/physicalsteps/FNV fields. UNKNOWN and rejected states do not become proof acceptance.

Freezer writes only exclusive fresh stage plans/output namespaces after streaming complete closure checks and reviewed source pins. This review does not execute that freezer or observe an actual frozen plan.
